# Laya Catch Me Up

Reads your own email, Teams chats and meetings and tells you what needs you, with replies owed, decisions made and deadlines coming, each linked to where it came from. For people with the paid Microsoft Copilot licence.

**Who can use it:** people with the paid Microsoft Copilot licence.

## What to upload

Nothing. It reads your own email, chats and meetings, and only what you can already see.

## What you get

A short list of what needs you, in order, then deadlines, decisions and things worth knowing, each with a link to the original.

## Example

Back after two weeks. You get four things that need you, the most urgent first, and two decisions made while you were away. It offers to draft the replies, and you decide what gets sent.

## Try saying

- *What needs me today?*
- *I've been on leave since [date]. What did I miss, and what needs me first?*
- *Catch me up on [project] over the last two weeks.*

## Tips

- It can't send anything. You read the draft and send it yourself.
- Open the original before acting on anything important. A summary can miss things.
